task: Close the live rehearsal integration gap where release-execution/source admission CI reaches exact-head Truth VERIFIED but the ordinary Lifecycle Closure Gate requires parent closure before the trusted multi-unit executor can run, and ensure lifecycle-gate failures enter canonical Failure Intake.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live source CI run 37528716724 on exact source head 0722b638464da13c540f54d603ee17fea807f51e passed Knowledge, Plan, Edit-Time, Replay, Release Risk, tests, typecheck, build and Completion Truth, then failed DEV_LIFECYCLE_CLOSE_REQUIRED because generic branch lifecycle semantics attempted to close the parent before the trusted release-unit executor could start. The same workflow omitted lifecycle-closure outcome from Failure Intake and produced zero records.
observableOutcomes: Ordinary feature/PR lifecycle closure semantics remain unchanged and continue to require a committed closed active plan after exact-head Truth.

Only push CI on release-execution/source/** may treat parent lifecycle closure as deferred to the already-merged trusted Release Unit Execution workflow, allowing source admission CI to finish successfully without closing the parent.
The source-admission exception does not grant write permission, does not close lifecycle locally and does not alter Completion Truth, Release Risk, decomposition or executor authority.
A failed Lifecycle Closure Gate is included in canonical Failure Intake with DEV_LIFECYCLE_CLOSE_REQUIRED so future lifecycle failures cannot disappear as zero-record intake.
Regression tests prove both narrow source-only deferral and ordinary-branch fail-closed lifecycle behavior.
unresolvedRisks: A broad lifecycle exemption could weaken ordinary Development Transaction closure.
A source branch could be misclassified by event/ref and bypass lifecycle outside the dedicated namespace.
Failure Intake could report lifecycle failures under an ambiguous generic code unless the workflow maps the exact step outcome.
Changing CI admission must not change the default-branch executor or any write-capable permission.

in: Adjust only existing CI lifecycle admission logic so release-execution/source/** push runs defer parent lifecycle closure to the trusted executor after exact-head Truth.
Add lifecycle-closure outcome to the existing Failure Intake code assembly using DEV_LIFECYCLE_CLOSE_REQUIRED.
Add regression assertions in existing Control Plane/operational intelligence tests.
out: No change to Release Unit Execution workflow write permissions, release-unit runtime, decomposition policy, Release Risk, Completion Truth, Lifecycle authority, CAS state or parent-close adapter.
No manual parent closure, receipt synthesis, state mutation or rehearsal child creation.
No storefront, admin, database, auth, payment, inventory, Builder or template behavior change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: The fix changes CI admission semantics adjacent to lifecycle and a write-capable downstream executor; the exception must be namespace- and event-bounded while preserving existing authorities.

acceptanceCriteria: A release-execution/source/** push whose exact-head canonical guards and Completion Truth pass is not required to persist the parent closed plan before Release Unit Execution starts.
The same lifecycle deferral is unavailable to pull_request, feature/**, fix/**, roadmap/** and other non-main branch CI contexts.
Normal Lifecycle Closure Gate behavior remains unchanged for ordinary Development Transactions.
Any lifecycle-closure failure is surfaced to shoperation-failure-intake.mjs as DEV_LIFECYCLE_CLOSE_REQUIRED.
Exact-head CI for this fix is green, Completion Truth is VERIFIED and this fix transaction itself reaches normal Lifecycle Closure before merge.
invariants: release-execution/source/** CI remains contents:read and cannot perform repository writes.
The trusted default-branch Release Unit Execution workflow remains the sole repository write surface for rehearsal execution.
Source admission never records parent lifecycle closure or closureEligible state.
Completion Truth and Lifecycle authority implementations are not modified.
Failure Intake addition records failures only; it cannot convert failure into success.

failureModes: Source admission CI incorrectly requires parent closure and blocks executor trigger.
Lifecycle deferral matches branches beyond release-execution/source/**.
Lifecycle gate fails but Failure Intake omits the outcome.
A workflow edit unintentionally widens permissions or alters trusted executor behavior.
edgeCases: Source CI reaches Truth VERIFIED while parent active plan remains implementation-ready by design.
A fix/** branch reaches Truth VERIFIED and must still require ordinary lifecycle closure.
Lifecycle transition itself fails before Lifecycle Closure Gate.
Release-execution/closure/** must not inherit source-admission deferral.

alternatives.summary: Keep ordinary lifecycle closure intact but explicitly defer parent closure only for release-execution/source/** push admission CI.
alternatives.reason: This matches the existing trusted workflow_run architecture and preserves parent closure for the executor after child units close.

alternatives.summary: Commit active-plan.closed.json on the source branch before executor start.
alternatives.reason: That would close the parent before child release units execute and directly violates the rehearsal lifecycle invariant.

alternatives.summary: Disable Lifecycle Closure Gate for all non-main pushes.
alternatives.reason: That would weaken the canonical Development Transaction lifecycle authority far beyond the bounded source-admission problem.

specialistReviews.finding: The gap is CI admission composition, not a missing lifecycle authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Preserve existing lifecycle producer and downstream parent-close adapter; alter only source admission conditions.

specialistReviews.finding: Any broad branch exemption could create a lifecycle bypass.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require push event plus exact release-execution/source/ namespace and retain contents:read in ordinary CI.

specialistReviews.finding: workflow_run executor can only start after source CI success, so source CI cannot simultaneously require final parent closure.
specialistReviews.resolution: Treat source CI as admission proof; parent lifecycle remains executor-owned after all units close.

specialistReviews.finding: Lifecycle closure failure was absent from generic Failure Intake assembly.
specialistReviews.resolution: Map lifecycle-closure outcome to DEV_LIFECYCLE_CLOSE_REQUIRED in the existing Failure Intake invocation.

challenge.scenario: A feature branch uses the same ready-for-implementation plan state.
challenge.finding: It must not receive source-admission lifecycle deferral.
challenge.resolution: Bound deferral to push plus startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release-execution/source/').

challenge.scenario: A source CI guard before lifecycle fails.
challenge.resolution: No change to workflow_run success condition; only a fully successful source CI can trigger execution.

challenge.scenario: Lifecycle Closure Gate fails in an ordinary transaction.
challenge.finding: Current Failure Intake can silently produce zero records.
challenge.resolution: Add lifecycle step outcome to the existing generic failure code assembly.

challenge.scenario: Closure persistence branch matches a non-main branch.
challenge.finding: It must use ordinary lifecycle semantics and must not re-enter source execution.
challenge.resolution: The exemption matches only release-execution/source/**, never release-execution/closure/**.

challenge.scenario: A release-execution/source push has a failing guard before Completion Truth.
challenge.finding: Lifecycle deferral must not turn a failed source admission into executor eligibility.
challenge.resolution: The trusted workflow_run still requires the whole CI workflow conclusion to be success; no gate outcome is rewritten.

challenge.scenario: A release-execution/source push modifies CI or executor code.
challenge.finding: Untrusted source content must not control downstream write-capable code.
challenge.resolution: The existing default-branch workflow_run executor continues to check out main; this fix changes only admission conditions in read-only CI.

challenge.scenario: The lifecycle transition producer returns a non-closure failure rather than closure_required=true.
challenge.finding: A source-specific deferral must not hide producer failure.
challenge.resolution: Defer only the expected parent-closure-required state after successful Completion Truth; producer execution errors remain failures.

challenge.scenario: Failure Intake sees lifecycle closure failure together with another failing gate.
challenge.finding: The lifecycle signal must coexist with other diagnostic codes without replacing them.
challenge.resolution: Append DEV_LIFECYCLE_CLOSE_REQUIRED to the existing semicolon-delimited generic failures only when lifecycle-closure outcome is failure.

proofPlan: Open this plan-only transaction from exact main and require Plan Before Code PASS before editing CI or tests.
Add regression assertions that ordinary Lifecycle Closure Gate remains and source admission deferral requires both push and release-execution/source/**.
Assert CI remains contents:read and Release Unit Execution retains separate write authority.
Assert Failure Intake includes steps.lifecycle-closure.outcome and maps failure to DEV_LIFECYCLE_CLOSE_REQUIRED.
Run exact-head Knowledge, Plan, Edit-Time, Replay, Release Risk, full tests, typecheck, build, Completion Truth and normal Lifecycle closure for this fix transaction.
Merge only after exact-head proof, verify fresh main CI, then replay the rehearsal from fresh main without manual state reconstruction.

requirements.requirement: Dedicated release-execution/source admission CI can finish after exact-head Truth without prematurely closing the parent, while ordinary transaction lifecycle closure remains mandatory.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No non-source CI context may receive lifecycle deferral.

requirements.requirement: Lifecycle Closure Gate failures are represented in the existing Failure Intake path instead of disappearing as zero-record failures.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A failed lifecycle closure step must not yield an empty generic Failure Intake solely because its outcome was omitted.
